title: ITR-3 Schedule HP (Income from House Property) - data
description: One entry per property, in Schedule HP's own item order. The annual value computation (a to e) and the section 24 deductions are represented as the form states them, so a filled tab can be read straight across to the utility.

occupancy.description: Item 1: self-occupied, let out, or deemed let out. Self-occupied has nil annual value and caps interest at Rs 2 lakh.

co_owners.description: Item 1(a): name, PAN and share of each other co-owner. Mandatory when co-owned.

tenants.description: Item 1(b): tenant name and PAN/TAN, required where TDS under 194-I applies.

municipal_tax_paid.description: Item 1(c) - only if actually paid in the year

annual_value.description: Item 1(d), stated by the document if it states one

standard_deduction_30pc.description: Item 1(e) - 30% of annual value. engine/ computes it

interest_on_borrowed_capital.description: Item 1(f), section 24(b). Capped at Rs 2 lakh for self-occupied; uncapped for let out, though the set-off against other heads is capped at Rs 2 lakh.
